Bitrise (YC, CI/CD for DevOps) | Senior/Staff Infrastructure Engineer | Remote (EU); Budapest, Hungary

Own the full stack for real: BGP/EVPN, transit, data center hardware, one of the world's largest Mac build fleets, and a private cloud spanning multiple locations — not just wiring up AWS components. Hybrid Linux/macOS environment, heavy Terraform/Ansible, usage. If blinking LEDs and routing tables get you going, this is the rare infra role where you can touch everything end-to-end.

https://bitrise.bamboohr.com/careers/130
